name: Land (Conduit Force of Nature)
body:
A connection to the land is a connection to the ground beneath you and all the world. They are suffused with the energies of the world on which they stand.

Manifestation: The conduit’s connection to the land can manifest in many ways, a dusty complexion, a smell of earth or stone, a small drift of dust falling from your hair, kicking up dust with your steps regardless of terrain, etc.

Communing: Communing with the land could be sifting through dirt, rolling smooth stones in your hand or stepping barefoot onto stone.

Connection Spells: (1st-level/0th) – resistance (2nd-level/1st) – stone shield (4th-level/2nd) – stone call (6th-level/3rd) – earth tremor (8th-level/4th) – stoneskin (10th-level/5th) – wall of stone (12th-level/6th) – move earth (14th-level/7th) – rampart (16th-level/8th) – earthquake (18th-level/9th) – imprisonment

Added Spells to Learn: Spells with the earth descriptor, spells that deal have stone or metal in their name or affect stone or metal. This includes spells that summon or transform but only if it grants the earth descriptor or involves a creature with the earth subtype.

Primal Empathy: The conduit gains the ability to communicate with creatures that live on land. This includes land animals and magical beasts, burrowing or underground fey, and earth elementals as well as other creatures that make their homes on land that do not fly at the GM’s discretion.

Natural Skill: Survival

Natural Movement: The conduit gains a 10-foot climb speed if climbing up a stone or earthen surface.

Untamed Land (Su)

Beginning with 1st level, so long as the conduit has 1 primal point remaining, they gain a +2 bonus on initiative checks and Knowledge (geography), Perception, Stealth, and Survival skill checks when in a natural, non-worked/urban setting.

Additionally, the conduit can expend a primal point to cause a minor earthen explosion beneath the target. So long as the target is touching the ground, they must make a Reflex save or take 1d4 bludgeoning damage per 2 class levels the conduit possesses. Then the conduit can make a combat maneuver attempt using their Charisma modifier in place of their Strength to attempt to trip the target. A successful save halves the damage and negates the trip attempt.

Feel of the Land (Ex)

Starting with 5th level, so long as the conduit has 1 primal point remaining, they gain a tremorsense of 10 feet so long as they are touching the ground. This range increases by 10 feet at 9th and 13th levels.

Hard Like Diamond (Su)

Starting with 9th level, as a standard action, the conduit can expend a primal point to grant a touched creature DR 10/adamantine for 1 round per class level. Only one instance of this ability may be active simultaneously.

Earthglide (Sp)

At 13th level, the conduit may expend a primal point as a standard action to grant themselves the benefits of the earthglide spell for a number of rounds equal to their class level. The rounds need not be used consecutively, but, any rounds not used the next time the conduit communes are lost.

Body of Earth (Ex)

At 17th level, the conduit no longer needs to have primal points remaining for the ongoing effects of the untamed land or feel the land abilities and the duration of the hard like diamond ability increases to 1 minute per class level.

Additionally, when using hard like diamond, you may grant all creatures within 5-feet of the target when the ability is activated, DR 5/adamantine for the same duration.
